 GTA 6: How To Register A New Vehicle 
 Gaming Tips & Guides · 1 min read GTA 6: How To Register A New Vehicle
 Cultured Vultures · November 18, 2026 GTA 6 
 In a bit of a change from the previous game in the series, you cannot actually buy new cars in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Well, technically, you can , just not in necessarily legal ways.
 At the outset of the game, you only have Jason’s Ganado registered, but you unlock the ability to register new vehicles when you make some progress through Chapter 2 . We estimate this will take 20+ hours of gameplay, depending on the player and how much of the side missions and general exploration they take part it.
 You unlock the ability to register cars shortly after meeting Moses , who will register the first car you bring to him for free, so make sure it’s a good one. The nearby Kolt & Associates hideout at La Cascara Motel has a very easily stealable Dominator. Moses also gives you a slim jim to make stealing cars a bit easier. Good guy Moses.
 The amount of cars you register depends on how many garages you have, which Moses will also make a possibility for you with the Vice City Real Estate app. You can then use your Scooter Bros app to get any of your registered cars instantly delivered to you for a fee, or pay $12k upfront to get three free deliveries a day, which really adds up. Once you make your way out of Gellhorn, you will be able to register vehicles at any Pay ‘n’ Spray across the map.
 If you ever destroy your vehicle or it gets impounded, you can use the Scooter Bros app to recover it, though for quite the premium.
 Grand Theft Auto 6 is available now on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
